name: llm-wiki
description: Keep research findings in a searchable project knowledgebase instead of re-deriving them.

interface.longDescription: Captures a finding and the source it came from in a project-local .kb store, or a global one, through the llmwiki command line tool. Search matches on meaning, so an answer written down in an earlier session comes back instead of being researched again.
defaultPrompt: Save what we just found out to the knowledgebase.
Search the knowledgebase before researching this.
